user.title: Connect to Glooko
user.description: Sign in with the same email and password you use at my.glooko.com. The integration only reads data; it never changes anything in your account.

data_description.region: Where your Glooko account lives. US accounts use us.my.glooko.com.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Glooko
reauth_confirm.description: Glooko rejected the saved credentials for {email}. Enter the current password.

error.two_factor: This Glooko account requires two-factor authentication, which is not supported yet.

abort.already_configured: This Glooko account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials belong to a different Glooko account.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll Glooko (5-60 minutes). Please keep it gentle.
data_description.stale_minutes: The 'Data stale' problem sensor turns on when the newest pump data is older than this.
data_description.sync_trigger_minutes: Glooko only pulls new pump data from Insulet when someone signs in on its website. The integration can do a website sign-in this often to keep data fresh (typically 35-65 min behind instead of hours). Minimum 15. The check runs on each poll, so set the polling interval to 5 min to get a true 15. Set to 0 to turn off.
